text: At its meeting on June 6, 2018, Etobicoke York Community Council approved Speed Limit Reductions on Superior Avenue, Stanley Avenue, Albert Avenue, Cavell Avenue, and Burlington Street from 50km/hr to 40km/hr. Stanley Avenue has a posted speed limit of 30km/hr, and should remain 30km/hr.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Re-opened Item EY31.53, headed "Speed Limit Reductions on Superior Avenue, Stanley Avenue, Albert Avenue, Cavell Avenue, and Burlington Street", adopted by Etobicoke York Community Council on June 6, 2018. 2. Amended Part 1 of that decision to exclude Stanley Avenue, so that it now reads: 1. Reduced the speed limits on Superior Avenue, Albert Avenue, Cavell Avenue, and Burlington Street from 50 km/hr to 40 km/hr.
